unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U27: Explain key pairs,verification,certificates and subscriber responsibility

payload.title: Signing and verification use different keys
payload.core_explanation_md:
In the described asymmetric system, the private key creates the digital signature and the corresponding public key verifies it. Verification addresses the signature relationship and whether the signed record has changed. It is not a general guarantee that every commercial statement in the document is true or that the signer had unlimited authority.

The Controller supervises certifying authorities and the relevant standards. A licensed certifying authority issues certificates under the statutory framework; the subscriber has the corresponding duties. Check the certificate and its status, the signature, the record integrity and the signer authority as separate parts of the file. An image of a handwritten signature is not automatically the same as this digital-signature process.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a valid digital signature prove every underlying factual assertion is accurate?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. It does not replace substantive transaction verification.

payload.stem_md: A verification procedure asks the customer to disclose the private key so the bank can check a signature. Which key performs the described verification role?

options.text_md: The private key must be shared with every verifier

options.explanation_md: The key pair uses different signing and verification roles.
That is not the described cryptographic verification key.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The key pair uses different signing and verification roles.

payload.stem_md: A digitally signed instruction is intact, but the signatory authority for this transaction is not established. Which conclusion is supported?

options.text_md: Signature integrity automatically creates unlimited authority
options.explanation_md: An intact signed record does not establish that its signer had power for the particular transaction.

options.text_md: The record must therefore be forged
options.explanation_md: Lack of authority proof is a different issue.

options.text_md: The certificate proves all business facts

options.explanation_md: Cryptographic verification and legal authority differ.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Cryptographic verification and legal authority differ.
